text: This is a 2018 medical billing app. We recorded six seconds of someone checking a claim for errors. That recording is all Resurrect gets.

Claude watches it and writes down thirty-two rules: twenty-four it saw happen, eight it's guessing. Only that list crosses a logged wall to Claude Code, which builds a brand-new app without ever seeing the original.
The rebuild reproduces all twenty-two lines of the old app's error log. Then we test it on cases it was never shown, like a child on a parent's insurance plan.
Every score is checked against the real old app. Run over run, it learns: zero of four hidden tests, then three of four.
The one miss is a bug in the old app. So Resurrect asks a human, right in A-S-I One: copy the old bug, or keep the fix? Record it. Resurrect rebuilds it, with proof.
